name: Oxford Fitness Center
address: Al Hilal Bank Building, Al Qusais 2, Dubai Unit Number 301, 303 - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description:
Dubai's most Elegant fitness-oriented center, our expert fitness trainers are ready to help you become the healthier version of yourself.
Oxford Fitness Center aims to set Dubai into a healthy land. Leads with experienced & certified world's best trainers. World-class fitness facility built to help you achieve your fitness goals. A variety of cardio and strength training equipment as well as group exercise programs. We offer health, recreational, and social facility geared towards exercise, sports, and other physical activities.

reviews.author: Liezel
reviews.text:
Oxford Gym is an excellent gym! 💪
The gym is clean, well-maintained, and the equipment is always in good condition and kept clean. The coaches are very accommodating, friendly, and professional.

My PT coach, Suhais, is a jolly and friendly person, but once the workout starts, he becomes serious and focused. He is an excellent coach who pushes me to my limits and motivates me to always give my best. He is approachable, down-to-earth, and very accommodating. I have learned many new workout techniques from him, which have helped me improve my strength, form, and overall performance. I really appreciate his dedication and the way he motivates me during every session.
Coach Faiz is one of the most experienced and skilled coaches I have ever met. He has excellent expertise in various training techniques and also has a good understanding of proper body massage and recovery after intense and heavy workouts. His guidance and experience have been very helpful in improving my workouts and overall fitness.
Coach Remya is also a friendly and experienced coach who is always approachable and supportive.
The people at the gym are also friendly, which creates a great and welcoming atmosphere.
Overall, I highly recommend Oxford Gym to anyone looking for a clean, well-equipped gym with knowledgeable and supportive coaches. I’m really happy with my experience here! 💪🔥
reviews.owner_reply: Your feedbacks are always valuable to us. It really meant great that our Entire team had motivated and inspired you in one or other way.We are always happy to hear all those real experiences in your fitness journey.Lets rise up together.

reviews.author: Manu Murali Nair
reviews.text:
Oxford Fitness Center is one of the best gyms in the Al Qusais area! The gym is very well-equipped with modern machines, free weights, and all the tools needed for a complete workout — whether you’re into strength training, cardio, or functional fitness.

The trainers here are extremely professional and supportive. A special mention goes to Coach Fayis, who stands out for his dedication, deep knowledge, and personalized training approach. His sessions are always well-structured, motivating, and tailored to help members achieve their goals efficiently. His professionalism and friendly attitude make workouts both challenging and enjoyable.

The supporting staff are also amazing — always welcoming, attentive, and ready to help. The gym maintains excellent cleanliness and hygiene, and the locker rooms and showers are kept spotless.

Another big plus is its easy accessibility, located conveniently near the metro station, making it very convenient for daily commuters.

Overall, the environment at Oxford Fitness Center is positive, energetic, and community-driven. It’s a place where you feel motivated to push yourself and enjoy every workout session.

Facility Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)
Trainer Professionalism: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)
Staff Support & Cleanliness: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a professional, well-maintained, and welcoming fitness center in Al Qusais!

reviews.author: Sudeesh
reviews.text:
Oxford Fitness Gym – Honest Feedback

I would like to share my genuine feedback about Oxford Fitness Gym after being a member for almost six months.

Firstly, I want to appreciate Mr. Fayis, who is an amazing trainer. He is very sincere, dedicated, and professional in his work.

Secondly, I want to thank the Oxford Fitness team for maintaining a friendly environment and building a good connection with clients. Your team’s approach is great for both customer satisfaction and business growth.

However, I would like to bring an important concern to the management’s attention. There are three other trainers (two male and one female) whose behavior is not professional. I’ve noticed that the two male trainers often spend time chatting, joking, and taking selfies with female clients instead of focusing on training. It sometimes seems like they are forming personal relationships rather than maintaining a professional atmosphere. The female trainer also appears to support this behavior.

This kind of conduct is not suitable for a fitness environment. I request the management to review this matter seriously and take appropriate action. If this continues, many genuine members may feel uncomfortable and might leave the gym.

Please be careful and take necessary steps to maintain the good reputation of Oxford Fitness.
